name: Kabid Nawshadri
indication_description:
Kabid Nawshadri is indicated in-
  • Weakness of stomach and liver
  • Hepatitis
  • Indigestion
pharmacology_description: This is a judicious combination of Embelia (Embelia ribes), Chebulic myrobalan (Terminalia chebula), Ginger (Zingiber officinale), Black pepper (Piper nigrum) and other valuable natural ingredients. It is a well known hepatoprotective unani medicine. It strengthens the liver and helps to relieve jaundice, hepatitis & indigestion. This is also effective in anorexia, nausea and vomiting.
dosage_description: 1-2 tablet(s) 2-3 times daily after meal or as prescribed by the physician.
side_effects_description: No significant side effect has been observed in therapeutic dosage.
precautions_description: Keep out of reach of the children.
storage_conditions_description: Store at cool and dry place, protect from light.
